correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, the exact affine unimodular substitution y_i=sum_{j>=i}x_j-c_i gives the order polytope of the path poset Q_S. All n-1 cover facets and all extrema facets are irredundant. Lattice facet volumes equal e(Q/e)/(n-1)! or e(Q\i)/(n-1)!, with native x-normal covolumes respectively 1 and sqrt(n-i+1). The special endpoint-turn profiles have n-1 linear extensions, identical summed cover contributions 1+(n-2)^2, and explicitly calculated boundary terms; a positive derivative and positive value at n=4 prove the all-n surface gap. An independent scipy ConvexHull enumeration reproduced volume and surface area for each of 124 profiles at n=3..7; analytic special-family counts were checked through n=12. Exhaustive finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete, naturally motivated Euclidean facet-area classification is obtained for all 2^(n-1) linked toric snake polytopes, extending their known volume invariant to the first Steiner boundary coefficient while respecting the nonorthogonal native metric. The explicit all-dimensional reversal gap at fixed volume and affine combinatorial equivalence demonstrates substantive new metric discrimination; it is not a one-off unmotivated parameter choice. The calculation is exact and gives individual facet measures, not only a generic formula for volume. No general isoperimetric extremum is claimed.
